title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00378751509478 (+0.64782% over #7717) with interleaved helper bases
body:
This construction gives **conditional κ ≥ 0.00378751509478**. Its certified lower endpoint exceeds the upper endpoint of PR #7717 by **0.00002437823416 (0.64782%)**. That gain is **15.24% larger** than the preceding gain of 0.00002115478655 reported in PR #7713. The new raw crossing lies in **[0.00378751509486, 0.00378751509487]**. [Construction proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3/research/p104-interleaved-helper-bases/PROOF.md) · [Complete application receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3/research/p104-interleaved-helper-bases/results/application.json)

Starting from the deposited PR #7713 circuit, 220 restrictions remove 230 paid returns. Twelve causal splits introduce fresh independent helpers. Fourteen paid pivots and nine hub reroutes complete the graph. Choosing different local equations at the same rank permits two independent splits at chart 288 and one at chart 306. Three counterexamples identify the exact input or output coefficients that fail under the alternate equations. [Edit journal](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3/research/p104-interleaved-helper-bases/EDITS.json) · [Witnesses and counterexamples](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3/research/p104-interleaved-helper-bases/results/witness.json)

| Complete 16-stage count | PR #7717 | This PR |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Paid recursive jobs | 100,416 | 96,512 |
| Productive recursive jobs | 20,656 | 17,296 |
| Productive rank mass less paid rank mass | 1,328 | 1,328 |

The verifier debits every retired helper and prices both sides of the new bill. The resulting margin weakly dominates PR #7717 for every increasing concave rank price that vanishes at zero. The directed power-price and compiler checks establish the strict κ gain.

## Verification

Run the five registered checks with CPython 3.12.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-interleaved-helper-bases
```

The forward and reverse sweeps check all 1,260 public fields. The catalogue checks cover 2,938 signed chart pairs and all 1,664 port-stage contacts. All 54 strict and four functional compiler predicates pass. The exact graph SHA-256 is `ba59d5db17c40185c8608a734ced10135d8c041e432c3840e9034868781c31a2`. [Manifest and replay instructions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3/research/p104-interleaved-helper-bases)

The hosted Ubuntu replay reproduced the bound and all five checked receipts at PR head `925719c8a`. The planning suite ran 760 tests with 24 skips, and the historical replay passed. [Scientific replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44370053645/job/135036752297) · [Complete CI run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44370053645)

All five commands also passed from a 59-file export of scientific commit `3ba9094c5` in a fresh directory without a Git checkout. It regenerated the same graph digest. The repository byte, executable-mode and source-history preflight passed in a separate full-history clone.

One finite cost increases. The sufficient scalar-step allowance per padded cell per service rises from 2²⁹ in PR #7717 to 2³⁰ here. PR #7718 tightened the scale for the older graph. The minimum grid for this graph is open.

The application inherits the five framework assumptions for native all-column application, owned erasure, recursive compilation, precision and tape accounting, and analytic recovery. Independent scientific review and practical multiplication timings remain open. An independent reconstruction of the last three restrictions is a bounded first review task. [Canonical finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19712230) · [Independent-reproduction handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19715190)

The first commit contains the complete scientific contribution. A separate commit carries the existing Clear1nsight/ToikY CI repair from #7257. Canonical main at `e54523517` fails `tests.test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests` because the CI guide still points at the older replay. The focused test and the historical replay both pass with this repair. All scientific files are in the first commit.

Ali Romman prepared this contribution with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. It uses the restrictions in #7713, the circuit export in #7716, Clear1nsight’s causal split and banked relay, DreamingOfClouds’ literal splits and signed-curvature gate, SYLforge’s signed word, the scalar recodings in #7708 and Rohan Arun’s caller lineage. The physical comparison comes from #7717. Jerry Chen / CubeJerry, Douglas Colkitt and the contributors credited in the source notices retain their framework and verification credit. [Credit and exact source links](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3/research/p104-interleaved-helper-bases/CREDITS.md)
